context: , for p > 2. We note that the question of NP-hardness for Euclidean MSD when the dimension d lies between 3 and log n i.e. 3 ≤ d < log n remains open. Based on this inapproximability result MSD can be proved APX hard, and even bicriteria APX hard for large dimension d = O(log n). For this aim we observe that the MDP problem in metrics of aspect ratio at most 2 can be viewed as a special case of the MSD problem. In such metrics the diameter of every cluster is either (i) 0 or (ii) ≥ 21 diam(S). Note the number of clusters of type (ii) is 1 (as more clusters would cost more than the trivial solution of a single cluster of all points). So for such metrics finding the best k clusters is equivalent to finding the minimum diameter subset of size n − k + 1.
